subgoals.description: Research and compile a list of potential venues in Edinburgh with key details
subgoals.success_criterion: List of 3-5 venues with names, locations, contact info, and features

subgoals.description: Select the most suitable venue and verify its details
subgoals.success_criterion: Chosen venue with confirmed address, capacity, pricing, and availability

subgoals.description: Draft a professional flyer using the selected venue's information
subgoals.success_criterion: Complete flyer text ready for printing or sharing
